description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/central_D_lat_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_meridional_zero_grad.esm — the rank-3 analogue of latlon_advection_meridional_zero_grad with passive lon (NLON=8) and lev (NLEV=4) axes. The problem is loaded once per resolution binding NLAT (odd, so the equator row exists for the max=1 assertion); the problem's dlat_deg observed divides by the NLAT name so geometry follows each rebinding. Forced-steady manufactured solution cos^4((pi/180) lat); the t=0.2 drift is pure interior O(dlat^2) truncation (the cos^4 profile is compatible with the zero-gradient pole rows to O(dlat^3)). expected_order 2.0; order_tolerance 0.25 (same as the 2-D sibling).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
